## EA Media Tools 2.6.2 - jaguar

### Faster library workflows

- Large audio folders now use asynchronous recursive indexing, up to 12 concurrent media probes, and a visible discovery/indexing/inspection animation with live counts.
- Simultaneous encoding is enabled by default after multiple sources are loaded. Audio queues run up to four compatible jobs together, NVENC keeps its adaptive scheduler, and the setting can force every queue back to one job at a time.

### Streaming and Cellular timing

- `presets.ini` now defines `frame_rate=23.976` for Streaming and Cellular and `frame_rate=passthrough` for the other built-in presets.
- Only sources above 24 fps are converted, using exact `24000/1001` constant-frame-rate timing. Existing encoded-audio timestamp resampling remains active, and a real 29.97 fps FFmpeg validation retained 48 kHz audio duration with error-free decoding.
- Streaming keeps `video_bitrate=0`; the encode window now reports rolling current bitrate so capped quality-based VBR can visibly relax on easy scenes.

### Live output

- rsgain-only normalization now appears in the live command output with the library path redacted.

[Review changes since v2.6.1](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.6.1...v2.6.2).
